leadText: Kanetsugu (Japanese: カネツグ) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest.
plainText:
Kanetsugu (Japanese: カネツグ) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest.

==In the games==

===Warlord information===
====Rank I====
 

====Rank II====
 

Transforms to Rank II by reaching a 60% link with Kadabra or Alakazam while Kenshin is in the same kingdom. (Cannot transform during )

===Default Pokémon===
 
 
===Links===
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
====Unobtainable links====
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

===Quotes===
Start of turn:
When asleep:
"Wake up!"
With low health or a status ailment: 
"This is grim..."
When victory is near:
"This path leads to victory!"
Otherwise:
"For honor!"

Start of battle:
When attacking a castle: 
"For all my beloved Pokémon!"
When defending a castle: 
"Our army will stand and fight!"

During battle: 
" , victories won with mere numbers will not sway the people's hearts. No, indeed! It is those won with honor which lead the world to truth."

When ordering to attack: 
" ! Now!"

When ordering to go to battle: 
To a kingdom:
"True justice knows no enemies. Let us go!"
To a wild Pokémon location:
"We must venture forth!"

Upon forming a link: 
" and I are now linked through our love of the just and the good."

When using an item: 
"You must use my ."

When using his Warrior Skill: 
"Know the true meaning of honor!"

After winning a battle:
If he attacked a castle:
"Behold! This is a victory for truth and honor!"
If he defended a castle:
"The dishonorable shall never set foot within this castle!"

When defeated:
If recruitable:
"We have fought tooth and nail, but I sense we could one day be allies."
If defeated by something other than the enemy:
"Oh... How embarrassing..."
Otherwise:
"Honor cannot be defeated... It must not be!"

When being recruited:
"Let us journey together toward the truth!"

When the player's army has conquered 10 kingdoms:
"Hm, 's army keeps getting stronger... Their selfish progress must be stopped by our love of honor!"

===Profile===
Warmhearted and very dutiful, he will always attempt to punish anyone he feels has been unjust, in a bid to show them the true path.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon + Nobunaga's Ambition ~ Ranse's Color Picture Scroll ~===
Kanetsugu debuted in PNA2.
 
====Pokémon====
 

 

==Trivia==
His use of is reminiscent of an .
The kanji on his helmet is the character for "love." Despite its unusual design, it is not a fictional creation but was featured on his helmet.

===Historical origin===
Kanetsugu is based on the real-life of Japanese history. He served as Kenshin's page and was married to Sen ( ).

His Psychic type specialty in Conquest may reference his service under Kenshin.
